column1: # Seven attempts to collapse the four release states into fewer, each executed
# as a REAL invocation of the shipped `wayland-release` binary against run A's
# otherwise-valid chain, so exactly one thing is wrong per attempt.
# Shape: F29-04-COLLAPSE-<n>::REFUSED::attempt=<name>::evidence=<path>
# Every refusal has a capture behind it with the exit status in it. A refusal
# claimed without a capture is an assertion, not a measurement.
# COLLAPSE-7 exists because COLLAPSE-2 was refused by the distinct-key-per-state
# rule, which fires BEFORE the role check -- so COLLAPSE-2 alone does not prove
# the role binding. COLLAPSE-7 repeats it with a freshly rotated packaging-role
# key so no key id repeats and the refusal must come from the ROLE.
# COLLAPSE-6 uses the exact state name an agent on this program actually
# invented to route around an artifact it wrongly believed unobtainable. Both
# doors are tried: the CLI value parser (rc=2) and a fifth record spliced
# straight into the chain JSON (rc=1, refused at deserialization by the closed
# enum, before any logic runs).
F29-04-COLLAPSE-1::REFUSED::attempt=relabel-packaging-as-acceptance::evidence=collapse-1-relabel.txt
F29-04-COLLAPSE-2::REFUSED::attempt=acceptance-signed-by-packaging-key::evidence=collapse-2-wrong-role-signature.txt
